points.description: Names a valid drawback of non-conventional machining: low metal removal rate / inefficient or slow material removal.
points.partial_credit: Half if only vaguely says it is slow or inefficient without link to removal.

points.description: Names another drawback from the model answer: requires high-skill labour, or is generally expensive/high cost.
points.partial_credit: Half if the idea is only hinted at (e.g. 'needs skill' or 'costly equipment') in a vague way.

rubric.notes: Full marks for stating about two of the drawbacks (low MRR, high-skill labour, high cost) in any wording; a student giving a single drawback correctly, e.g. only 'low MRR', gets 1 mark, though a very clear single answer may be given generous half-marks on the other point. 0 for unrelated answers. Extra incorrect remarks do not cost marks unless they contradict these drawbacks.
